## findplus auth
Sign in to a provider (Google via Chrome, or Apple interactively).

**Usage:** `findplus auth [OPTIONS]`

| option | default | help |
|---|---|---|
| --provider | google-find-hub | Provider to authenticate: google-find-hub or apple-find-my |

## findplus config get
Print the value of KEY from config.env, or empty if unset.

**Usage:** `findplus config get [OPTIONS]`

## findplus config list
Print all KEY=VALUE pairs in config.env.

**Usage:** `findplus config list [OPTIONS]`

## findplus config path
Print the path to config.env.

**Usage:** `findplus config path [OPTIONS]`

## findplus config set
Write KEY=VALUE to config.env after validating through Settings.

**Usage:** `findplus config set [OPTIONS]`

## findplus config unset
Remove KEY from config.env.

**Usage:** `findplus config unset [OPTIONS]`

## findplus db current
Print the current Alembic revision of the database.

**Usage:** `findplus db current [OPTIONS]`

## findplus db path
Print the absolute path to the SQLite database file.

**Usage:** `findplus db path [OPTIONS]`

## findplus db upgrade
Run Alembic migrations to head. Safe to run repeatedly (idempotent).

**Usage:** `findplus db upgrade [OPTIONS]`

## findplus devices
List Find Hub devices and choose which ones to track.

**Usage:** `findplus devices [OPTIONS]`

| option | default | help |
|---|---|---|
| --track |  | Track this device id (repeatable). |
| --track-all |  | Track every device on the account. |
| --untrack |  | Stop tracking a device id. |
| --default |  | Device the dashboard opens on. |
| --refresh |  | Re-query Find Hub for the list. |

## findplus doctor
Diagnose the installation; with --repair, fix what can be fixed.

**Usage:** `findplus doctor [OPTIONS]`

| option | default | help |
|---|---|---|
| --repair |  | Attempt automatic fixes for repairable checks. |
| --json |  | Print machine-readable JSON. |

## findplus export
Export history to CSV, JSON, GPX or KML.

**Usage:** `findplus export [OPTIONS]`

| option | default | help |
|---|---|---|
| --format | csv |  |
| --day |  | Single local day, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| --start |  | Range start, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| --end |  | Range end, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| --all |  | Export the entire history. |
| --device-id |  | Limit to one device. Omit for all devices. |
| --group |  | Export every member's track (never merged). |
| --output, -o |  |  |

## findplus install-service
Start the background service (D15): auth check, then tracked-devices

**Usage:** `findplus install-service [OPTIONS]`

| option | default | help |
|---|---|---|
| --yes |  | Write and load the service files without asking. |
| --no-open |  | Do not open the dashboard in a browser. |
| --program, -P |  | Path to the daemon executable. The desktop app passes /Applications/Find+.app/Contents/MacOS/findplus-daemon here. |

|---|---|---|
| --yes |  | Skip the confirmation prompt. |
